second_band_forecast.basis: Measured asymptotic period 872.66973123454 and first negative band 664..1099; nominal ranks supplied by user. No finite asymptotic remainder bound.

nearby_shift_scan.rule: Report every negative and unresolved cell; do not describe global first failure. Compare all contiguous minors actually tested, including historical grid.

mixture_path.rule: Exact rational parameters fixed before window trials. Require complete atlas and disjoint root disks well below pair separation. Keep common N192 and precision checks; finite positive sections do not lower-bound full detection support.

scope: Private pre-registration record. File timestamp and hashes are local evidence, not an independent public timestamp.
